blocks.content: Every note is a stack of **blocks**. A block is written in markdown while you edit it and drawn nicely when you leave it: *italic*, **bold**, `code`, ~~strikethrough~~.

| Item | Qty | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Apples | 6 | |
| Milk | 1 | 2% |
| Bread | 2 | whole wheat |

- [x] Build the thing
- [ ] Test the thing
- [ ] Show someone the thing

**Left column**

Blocks that share a row sit side by side. Drag the handle on a block to rearrange.

**Right column**

Right-click a block to change its alignment and colors, or to unhook it and float it anywhere on the note.
Hold **Ctrl** to enter organize mode: click blocks to select them, then drag them to rearrange, including into columns or out onto the note as floating blocks.

floating.content:
**A floating block**

This one is unhooked from the flow. Drag it anywhere, resize it, or right-click it to hook it back in.
